newsitem.title: USA: News Corp close to Primestar deal - Variety.
newsitem.headline: News Corp close to Primestar deal - Variety.

text.p: News Corp Ltd may be close to a deal to merge its ASkyB satellite TV venture into Primestar, Daily Variety said.
In Thursday's edition, Variety said one of the more prominent partners in Primestar, Time Warner Inc, was debating the structure of such a deal rather than rejecting it out of hand.
Primestar is a venture owned by several major cable companies, including Tele-Communications Inc and Time Warner.
TCI President Leo Hindery has told Wall Street analysts and money managers in recent days about his optimism for a deal and predicted it could be announced this week, unnamed sources told Variety.
A TCI spokeswoman confirmed talks at the highest levels of the companies were taking place, but she declined to comment further, Variety said.
A venture with Primestar would replace the now-abandoned deal News Corp had reached several months ago with EchoStar Communications Corp. Time Warner declined comment.

Time Warner's ability to block a deal long-term is in doubt since the Primestar partnership is being restructured into a public company and in that new structure the partners may lose veto power over such deals, Variety said.
